user.title: Select the MaTouch ESPHome device
user.description: Select the ESPHome action that returns the MaTouch runtime manifest.

device.title: Name this MaTouch device
device.description: Choose the Home Assistant name for the parent MaTouch controller device. The device is added without configured pages; configure them afterwards from the integration options. Functional-page headers follow the Home Assistant names of the page child devices.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MaTouch page
reconfigure.description: Select a compiled functional page. Configured pages can be edited; unconfigured pages can be configured now. ✓ configured page · ○ page not configured.

reconfigure_page_control.title: Configure MaTouch page
reconfigure_page_control.description: Page: {page_title} · Template: {template} · Control {control_slot} · Function: {function} · Step {position} of {total}. The page is saved atomically only after all required controls are valid.

reconfigure_control.title: Select MaTouch control
reconfigure_control.description: Page: {page_title}. Select one control. All other mappings will remain unchanged.

reconfigure_mapping.title: Edit MaTouch control
reconfigure_mapping.description: Page: {page_title} · Control: {control_label} · Function: {function}. Only this mapping will be changed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not obtain the runtime manifest from the ESPHome device.
error.invalid_manifest: The ESPHome device returned an invalid or incompatible runtime manifest.
error.invalid_mapping: The selected Home Assistant entity or page configuration is invalid.
error.invalid_selection: Select a valid page or control.

abort.manifest_unavailable: No compatible ESPHome MaTouch runtime manifest action is available.
abort.already_configured: This MaTouch device is already configured with the selected ESPHome action.
abort.transport_reassociated: The existing MaTouch device now uses the selected ESPHome action. Its mappings were kept.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not obtain the runtime manifest from the ESPHome device.
abort.invalid_manifest: The ESPHome device returned an invalid or incompatible runtime manifest.
abort.invalid_mapping: The saved mappings are incompatible with the current runtime manifest.

page.title: MaTouch menu
page.description: Choose a page to configure, the device name, active pages or page order. Each confirmed change is saved at once. Done closes the menu. ✓ configured page · ○ page not configured.

page_saved.title: MaTouch menu
page_saved.description: Saved in Home Assistant, configuration revision {config_revision}. The display synchronizes automatically while the unit is connected. The Runtime configuration sensor shows the saved revision; the Stare sincronizare MaTouch entity of the ESPHome device shows the state reported by the display. ✓ configured page · ○ page not configured.

device.title: Edit MaTouch display name
device.description: This name belongs to the parent MaTouch controller device and is saved when you confirm. To change a functional-page header, rename that page child device in Home Assistant.

page_control_select.title: Choose page slot
page_control_select.description: Page: {page_title}. Choose a slot to add, replace, rename or remove its mapping. Each confirmed slot is saved at once. ○ marks a slot without a mapping.

page_control.title: Edit MaTouch page
page_control.description: Page: {page_title} · Template: {template} · Control {control_slot} · Function: {function} · Control {position} of {total}. The change is saved when the page or slot is complete; an incomplete page is not saved.

active_pages.title: Manage active MaTouch pages
active_pages.description: This changes only the device-local active functional-page mask. Mappings and revisions are not changed. The device remains authoritative.

page_order.title: Manage MaTouch page order
page_order.description: Enter every compiled functional page slot exactly once, separated by commas, in the desired navigation order. The device remains authoritative; mappings, active pages and revisions are not changed.

error.invalid_mapping: The selected Home Assistant entity or page configuration is invalid.
error.active_mask_unavailable: Could not read the device active-page mask. No change was sent.
error.active_mask_invalid_selection: Select at least one compiled functional page.
error.active_mask_invalid_response: The device returned an invalid active-page response. The observed state is stale.
error.active_mask_rejected: The device rejected the active-page change and kept its returned effective state.
error.active_mask_result_unknown: The active-page write could not be confirmed. No automatic retry was attempted; refresh before trying again.
error.page_order_unavailable: Could not read the device page order. No change was sent.
error.page_order_invalid_selection: Enter every compiled functional page slot exactly once in the desired order.
error.page_order_invalid_response: The device returned an invalid page-order response. The observed state is stale.
error.page_order_rejected: The device rejected the page-order change and kept its returned effective order.
error.page_order_result_unknown: The page-order write could not be confirmed. No automatic write retry was attempted; the device was read back instead.

abort.manifest_unavailable: The configured MaTouch runtime manifest action is unavailable.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not obtain the runtime manifest from the ESPHome device.
abort.invalid_manifest: The ESPHome device returned an invalid or incompatible runtime manifest.
abort.invalid_mapping: The saved mappings are incompatible with the current runtime manifest.
abort.menu_closed: MaTouch menu closed. Saved changes are kept.

device_uid.name: Device UID
device_uid.description: Stable UUID of the MaTouch device.

protocol_version.name: Protocol version
protocol_version.description: MaTouch protocol version used by the device.

boot_id.name: Boot ID
boot_id.description: Identifier generated by the device for its current boot.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: Unique command identifier used for deduplication.

command.name: Command
command.description: Function requested by the mapped control.

page_slot.name: Page slot
page_slot.description: One-based page slot exposed by the device manifest.

control_slot.name: Control slot
control_slot.description: One-based template-defined control slot within the page.
